segments.name: Real-world data
segments.description: Real-world data platform giving life sciences and healthcare customers access to curated clinical and imaging datasets.
segments.evidence: The CODM manages its operations and allocates resources based on the Company's consolidated results and therefore operates as one segment.

revenueModel.text: Life science companies pay to license de-identified clinical data for specific research opportunities.
revenueModel.evidence: All data remains "native" within the federated OneMedNet iRWDTM provider network - meaning all the data remains locally onsite until specific de-identified data is licensed for a particular life science research opportunity.

changes.text: In 2025 the company decommissioned its legacy BEAM platform as part of its transition to a unified real-world data platform.
changes.evidence: The Company decommissioned its legacy BEAM platform in May 2025 as part of its strategic transition to a unified real-world data platform.
